matras.name: आ की मात्रा
matras.hinglish: When Hinglish writes 'aa' or a long 'a' (naam, kaam), Hindi uses ा after the letter.

matras.name: इ की मात्रा
matras.hinglish: A short 'i' in Hinglish (din, kitab) is ि. You hear it after the letter, but you write it BEFORE.

matras.name: ई की मात्रा
matras.hinglish: Hinglish 'ee', or an 'i' at the end of a word (paani, nadi), is the long ी.

matras.name: उ की मात्रा
matras.hinglish: A short 'u' in Hinglish (tum, gulab) is ु, hanging under the letter.

matras.name: ऊ की मात्रा
matras.hinglish: Hinglish 'oo', or a long 'u' (phool, doodh), is ू, also under the letter.

matras.name: ए की मात्रा
matras.hinglish: Hinglish 'e' (mela, seb) is े: one little flag on top of the line.

matras.name: ऐ की मात्रा
matras.hinglish: Hinglish 'ai' (paisa, kaisa) is ै: two flags on top of the line.

matras.name: ओ की मात्रा
matras.hinglish: Hinglish 'o' (mor, roti) is ो: a ा stick with one flag.

matras.name: औ की मात्रा
matras.hinglish: Hinglish 'au' or 'ou' (mausam, kaun) is ौ: a ा stick with two flags.

matras.name: ऋ की मात्रा
matras.hinglish: Hinglish 'ri' after a letter (Krishna, mrig) is often the little hook ृ under it.

matras.name: अनुस्वार
matras.hinglish: A Hinglish 'n' or 'm' before another letter (Ganga, hans) is often just a dot ं on top.

matras.name: विसर्ग
matras.hinglish: A Hinglish 'ah' at the end of a word (praatah, namah) is two dots ः after the letter.
